name: morpheus-inference
description: Send chat and embedding requests to Morpheus, a decentralized AI inference network, through api.mor.org or your own Uplink.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY.title: Morpheus API key
MORPHEUS_API_KEY.description: Your inference key (sk-...) from app.mor.org, or an inference key issued by your own Uplink. Stored by Cursor, never in this repo.

MORPHEUS_MODE.title: Mode
MORPHEUS_MODE.description: api.mor.org = the public Morpheus API. uplink = your own Uplink (set the base URL).

MORPHEUS_BASE_URL.title: Base URL
MORPHEUS_BASE_URL.description: Uplink mode only: your Uplink's OpenAI-compatible base, for example https://uplink.example.com/v1. Ignored in api.mor.org mode.

MORPHEUS_MODELS.title: Model hierarchy
MORPHEUS_MODELS.description: Optional. Chat models to try, comma-separated, most preferred first (applies to morpheus_chat only). On an error or timeout the next model is tried; if none works, or none is set, the tool tells your agent to use its own model.
